notes.title: Porcelana is going Free-to-Play
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It's hard to believe, but almost 3 years have passed since the release of [i]Porcelana[/i], and we want to express our deepest thanks to everyone who has supported the game and our team. Whether you bought the game or simply shared it with others, your support has meant the world to us.

After much consideration, we've decided to make [i]Porcelana[/i] Free-to-Play [b]starting next week[/b] (September 16th). Why? Because we want Porcelana to reach even more hearts by making it accessible to as many people as possible.

For those of you who already purchased the game, we sincerely thank you. If you'd like to continue supporting the game after it goes Free-to-Play, you can do so by purchasing the OST.

Thank you again for being a part of this journey!

[h3]About this update[/h3]

[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

notes.title: Porcelana v1.1.3 Minor bug fixing
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This is a minor bug fixing update. We fixed minor bug that causes that you can't adjust music and sfx volume in some chapters. Also we fixed a couple english typos.

We will keep updating Porcelana if we find any other bug or problem. In addition, you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/Z3aNf26EaZ]official Discord server[/url] to report any problem.

Regards, [i]Pandita Studio Staff.[/i]
